body_lead: Odisha to Install 300 More AI-Powered Cameras in Similipal to Curb Wildlife Poaching The Odisha government is planning to install 300 additional AI-powered surveillance cameras in Similipal Tiger Reserve to strengthen wildlife protection and prevent illegal hunting and unauthorised entry into the forest. The initiative aims to enhance round-the-clock monitoring, detect suspicious activities and improve wildlife conservation.
